title: Swearing by God’s life — Vivit Dominus / Vivo Ego
source_text: XVIII. Inde quoque natus est mos in Scriptura probatus jurandi per Dei vitam. Nam pii homines in juramentis suis saepe hanc formulam usurpant, Vivit Dominus. Et Deus ipse dum, ut sese nobis attemperet, jurans introducitur, utitur his verbis, Vivo Ego.
pass_a_gloss: From there also arose the custom approved in Scripture of swearing by the life of God. For pious men in their oaths often use this formula, The Lord lives. And God Himself, when, that He may accommodate Himself to us, is introduced as swearing, uses these words, I live.

lemmas.gloss: of swearing by the life of God

choices.english: of swearing by the life of God
choices.why: Shows life-language entering oath practice in Scripture.
rejected: Scripture forbids all oaths by God’s life
